rationale: Imported design colors are copied into Theme by token name, while Pulp controls resolve widget-specific names such as `knob.arc`, `knob.arc.bg`, and `knob.thumb`. A design that supplied only the documented semantic palette therefore colored panels and text but left every knob on Pulp's built-in blue. This Pulp-only compatibility mapping derives absent widget tokens from the imported semantic palette using the same relationships as the built-in themes, while preserving every explicitly supplied widget token and inventing nothing when no semantic accent exists. It changes only the Pulp DesignIR-to-Theme projection and does not alter the transferred schema or add a separate source of token authority.
